result:
I’d make it so people could truly understand one another’s suffering—not as an abstract idea, but as something felt.

Most cruelty, indifference, and exploitation survive because other people’s pain is easy to ignore when it isn’t “real” to us. If every person had a direct, undeniable sense of the consequences of their actions on others, I think war, exploitation, neglect, and casual cruelty would collapse faster than any law or technology could achieve.
